policy.notes: Snapshots are ignored by the workspace Git repository. Copy code into production only after reviewing license, host compatibility and security.

sources.role: official Photoshop UXP APIs, WebSocket, events, layer operations and Electron desktop-helper pattern
sources.adopt: Use desktop-helper and contract patterns; do not copy arbitrary command execution.

sources.role: official legacy-compatible HTML panel and ExtendScript bridge examples
sources.adopt: Use host bridge and event patterns; never expose the sample's browser-driven arbitrary ExtendScript surface.

sources.role: optional UXP TypeScript/Vite/build and CCX packaging boilerplate
sources.adopt: Evaluate as the Photoshop/Premiere UXP build shell after the protocol works in the official sample.

sources.role: SVG/PNG sheet extraction, palette metadata, manifests and optional local VLM naming
sources.adopt: Use as an offline preprocessing tool or implementation reference; do not make the runtime depend on Inkscape, Potrace or Ollama initially.

sources.role: icon catalog schema, FTS5 plus vector ranking, license filters and batch retrieval
sources.adopt: Borrow schema and ranking ideas; do not bring its Next.js/Turso/Gemini stack into the local toolkit without a measured need.
